topics.name: MeritCore Project Evidence Binding
topics.purpose: Define exact consumption of Project participation/result evidence by MeritCore without transferring Project semantic ownership.

semantics.project_rule: Merit evidence references exact Project identities.
semantics.result_rule: Result/deliverable/acceptance evidence may be consumed explicitly.
semantics.ownership_rule: Project remains owner of Project semantics; MeritCore owns derived merit interpretation.
semantics.leaf_rule: Leaf/composite Project treatment is explicit by merit profile.
semantics.public_rule: Public ranking/projection uses only permitted Project/Merit evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Project completion does not automatically grant fixed merit.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: Project name used as evidence identity
